picks.excerpt: Jon Erwin walks through exactly how his July 4th-weekend historical drama 'Young Washington' used generative AI, scene by scene. The production employed five AI artists plus an AI producer and crew member, with Erwin arguing the tech made the shoot 'safer and more affordable.' The film opened nationwide July 3 and is over-performing at the box office.

The Next Lab Generation program required its six finalist teams to develop pitches using Meta's Quill VR animation software and the Magnific AI upscaler before pitching in Madrid. Cartoon Brew's rundown of the finalist projects finds most teams leaned into VR workflows while quietly dropping the mandated AI tool.

With film and TV work drying up, veteran writers and crew are taking RLHF gigs — rating and refining generative AI outputs for tech companies. THR profiles workers who are effectively polishing the systems that may render their old jobs obsolete.

OpenArt, founded by ex-Googlers, launched 'Director,' a model/tool pitched at both working Hollywood directors and 'everyday Finchers' — promising conversational, iterative control over AI-generated footage, a workflow the company brands 'vibe directing.'
